principle: No global odds cap. Eligibility limits belong to individual validated strategies. Core market families are enabled now. Deferred market families are explicitly retained in the PBK roadmap and must not be treated as permanently excluded; each requires its own data-quality and multiple-testing protocol before activation.
time_scope: FULL_TIME_REGULATION unless a strategy explicitly preregisters another settlement convention

allowed_market_families.line_policy: No global line restriction; each hypothesis fixes its line/line-family before TEST
No global line restriction; common examples ТБ/ТМ(1.5, 2.0, 2.25, 2.5, 2.75, 3.0, 3.5)

deferred_market_universe.reason: High-dimensional outcome space; requires dedicated multiple-testing and liquidity controls
Correlated legs and large hypothesis space require separate validation
Provider-specific pricing and correlation model required

deferred_market_universe.label_ru: Игроки: голы, удары, передачи, карточки и прочие props
deferred_market_universe.reason: Needs player identity, lineup, minutes and settlement-quality layer
Separate event-statistics and market-history layer required
Referee/player/context dependence and bookmaker settlement differences
Provider-stat definition consistency must be validated first
Requires stable event-stat source and market coverage

deferred_market_universe.label_ru: Таймы, интервалы времени, гол до/после минуты
deferred_market_universe.reason: Settlement/time-event precision and much larger search space

deferred_activation_rule: Deferred does not mean rejected. A deferred family may enter core only after a dedicated data-source audit, preregistration, frozen discovery sample where needed, and an independent future holdout. No family is activated because of a single attractive example.
guardrails: A market being enabled for research does not make it a strategy or bet.
Every new strategy freezes market, selection, line logic, odds logic, stake and settlement before TEST.
No post-result substitution between related markets, e.g. ТБ(2.5) -> ИТБ2(1.5) or ОЗ — Да.
No global maximum odds. A 4.40 or higher selection is permitted if a separately validated strategy selects it.
Existing R1/R2 retain 1.20 <= selected away odds < 2.10 and are not widened by this market scope.
Deferred exotic markets remain mandatory roadmap items but may not contaminate current core hypothesis testing.
